seo_title: Over Your Lease Miles? Buying the Car vs. Paying the Charge
takeaways: Excess-mileage charges are usually billed when you return the car.
If you buy the car instead, there's normally no turn-in inspection and no mileage bill.
High miles also lower the car's value, so compare both paths before you decide.
